summary: LTX spatial upscaler bench evaluation - successor to the dropped SeedVR2. Weight and nodes are already on disk/core, so no integration tax; the decisive test is the radial-FFT top/mid character measurement plus the 16 GB ceiling.

Folded in the upscale-then-interpolate idea rather than carding it separately: fewer frames per pass moves the chunk ceiling and the interpolator enforces temporal coherence. rife47.pth is on disk and the interpolation nodes are core.
MPI-557 is now blocked on this card - unblock it when this bench reports.
Implementation started - bench evaluation of the LTX spatial upscaler.
Checklist derived from the new plan.md - 7 phases, 6 and 7 gated on the phase 4 radial-FFT verdict.
Ownership written to files.json: the card workspace only. Bench card - it edits no repo code by design.
Fabio closed Q2/Q3/Q5 by eye - sigma 0.50 keeps her, keeps the iris, keeps the zipper; 0.85 replaces the person and deletes the zipper. sigmas IS the exposed knob.

Wavy distortion root-caused to the LTX VAE round trip (13x codec floor), amplified ~2x by the temporal upscaler. Frame-count and geometric-warp hypotheses both falsified by their own controls. New instrument wave.py; ground-truth redo done with legal 8n+1 counts.
Q2/Q3/Q5 checked off plus the fps fix and the ground-truth redo; hybrid temporal arm, attention_mask, x1.5 and clip B remain.

Corrected: sigmas is NOT the change knob - it moves change and quality together. Built the op Fabio asked for instead: detail transfer, 63% less drift at full reconstruction, also attenuates the swim, no GPU, adjustable after the run. Controlled against a drift-matched unsharp mask.

x1.5 spatial upscaler does NOT solve the VRAM ceiling - 15484 MB peak against x2 15301 with 43% fewer output pixels. It is 40% faster (157s vs 263s). First uncontended full-length timing: 97 s per second of footage at 2x.

Split-radius sweep DONE and NEGATIVE. r=2..20 on frames 12/40/65: invention/reconstruction ratio worst at r=2 (0.511), best at r=8-10 (0.345), and every drift-matched strength twin sits at a constant 0.347 - radius is strength in disguise. Luma-only arm negative too: the veins are luma, not a red cast. Leave the radius at 10.

The measurement that killed the radius hypothesis named the control that works: an EVIDENCE-GATED transfer, weighting the transfer by the sources own local high-pass so flat skin and flat fabric get nothing. Proof on an untuned region - ungated detail-100 invents three red dots on plain fabric, the gated arm loses them and keeps the seams buttons. FULL_gated132.mp4 rendered at 81 frames, drift-matched to FULL_detail100.mp4. band_split.py may NEVER score the gate: it shares the gates statistic. Awaiting Fabios eyes.

Fabios verdict on the evidence gate: PARTIAL PASS. Veins gone; fabric speckles only partly gone (the three dots was an under-count from one crop); expressions lost; a new face artifact that feels like bad interpolation. Leading hypothesis for the last: the gate is recomputed per frame and flickers, pulsing the detail layer. Zero GPU to test.

THE POSITIVE PROMPT IS AN UNCONTROLLED VARIABLE UNDER EVERY MEASUREMENT ON THIS CARD. build_v2v.py conditions on a woman s face in close up, natural skin texture, freckles, sharp eyes by default and always has - it ASKS for the speckled skin every downstream dial has been filtering out. cfg 1 also makes the negative prompt inert. Re-baseline sigma 0.85 with a neutral and an empty prompt before any more post-processing work.

Positive prompt CONFIRMED as the cause of the cheek moles - Fabio on PROMPT_cheek_f12.png: two moles, the model rendering the prompt s freckles. Neutral and empty arms are clean. Default changed to neutral in build_v2v.py, sweep.py and full_arms.py; every arm made before today is contaminated. It does NOT fix identity replacement at sigma 0.85. Re-baseline nb_s050_x2 + nb_s085_x2 in flight. Three high-pass measures were built for this and all three failed their own controls - quote none of them.

Re-baseline landed: nb_s050_x2 (294s, 15868 MB) and nb_s085_x2 (258s, 15481 MB), 81 frames, neutral prompt. nb_s085_x2 vs its contaminated twin full_s085_x2 on frames 40 and 65: the old cheeks carry a speckle field, the new ones are clean. The artifact was prompt-ordered and six words removed it with no post-processing. Unchanged: 0.85 still replaces the person, the swim and the VAE damage are untouched, and the fabric dots belong to the transfer re-run. The evidence gate may now have no job left - re-look before spending more on it. nb_s050_x2_00001.mp4 awaits the ship/no-ship eye call in motion.

SHIP/NO-SHIP PASSED. Fabio watched nb_s050_x2 in motion: "050 holds up motion, the best result we had so far." Also corrected the card: 0.85 STAYS on the slider - identity replacement and object deletion are trades a user chooses at the top of a denoise range, not defects, and identity restoration via LoRAs belongs to other flows. Range ships 0.15-0.85. He sees 0.85 as useful for animation, cartoons and anime.

DETAIL TRANSFER AND EVIDENCE GATE CLOSED NEGATIVE, root-caused. Fabio on T50from85_035/070 in motion: morphing mouth at 35, prominent eye morphing at 70, "eyes open and closed at the same time, like two frames fighting", face "stamped on". The op assumed the donor re-renders texture while leaving the performance alone; at sigma 0.85 the model regenerates expression, so donor frame i is a different moment than base frame i and the transfer stamps one expression onto another. This also explains the gate verdict from earlier today (expressions lost, bad interpolation), which the plan had recorded as unexplained - so the temporal-smoothing test is DROPPED as a wrong hypothesis. Stills could never show it: the defect exists only across frames. Product keeps ONE control, sigmas.

THE CARD BENCHED THE WRONG SOURCE CLASS. Fabio: the real application is AI-generated footage at low resolution needing a bump, not the degraded phone clip every arm here used. He is supplying the right video (G:/ComfyUi/ComfyUI/input/). The sigma ladder re-runs on it and it supersedes the never-landed clip B cross-check. The slider default is UNSETTLED until then - 0.50 is the best position on the wrong source class, and a clean synthetic source may want less regeneration.

THE CFG RANGE RAN AND BOTH SLIDERS ARE NOW FULLY SPECIFIED. cfg_range.py (cfg 2/5/7 at sigma 0.85, contradictory red-biker clause) completed at 122s/15290MB, 86s/15235MB, 86s/15195MB, and a base-prompt control (cfg_base.py: cb_s085_cfg5base 116s, cb_s085_cfg7base 86s) was added on top - that control is what the range actually rests on. THREE RESULTS. (1) STEERING NEVER SATURATES: prompt influence measured at FIXED cfg, so cfg's own move is divided out, climbs 3.869 -> 9.231 -> 15.948 -> 21.158 with no knee, and the cfg-3 figure reproduces the earlier session's 9.231 exactly across a re-run. So the stop is not diminishing returns. (2) THE BREAK IS AT cfg 5, NOT THE PREDICTED 7: cfg 5 already shows cyan/green speckle across the wagon, blown contrast and a made-up face on two separate frames (36 and 60); cfg 7 turns the driver into a white mask with a red mouth. (3) THE DAMAGE IS CFG'S, NOT THE CONTRADICTORY PROMPT'S - cb_s085_cfg5base carries the SAME speckle, hoop rims and white blobs as its red twin and cb_s085_cfg7base is broken the same way, so a distilled transformer at cfg 5 breaks on ANY prompt. Whole-frame diffs agree: base 17.063/23.720 vs red 17.672/25.383, so nearly all movement above cfg 3 is cfg itself. Also refined what the prompt does: at cfg 2-3 the jacket gains lapels, collar, gold cord and studs and a RED collar/scarf appears UNDERNEATH - the model ADDS a red garment element rather than repainting the blue jacket, so raising cfg never eventually recolours it, it just adds more until the additions are artifacts. cfg is free: peak 15163-15528 MB flat, 86-91s warm. Sheets CFGR_wide_f36.png, CFGR_driver_f36.png, CFGR_driver_f60.png, CFGR_base_f36.png in D:/WORK/Images/Outputs/mpi568/.

Ticked the AI-source sigma ladder (ran on both targets; Fabio narrowed the range to 0.50-0.85 and the in-between rungs put 0.675 at 41% of the way on BOTH source classes), the cfg mapping (it turned out to be far more than "does the negative prompt do anything" - unpinning cfg amplifies steering 2.4x and became the second slider), and the cfg ladder plus its base-prompt control.

maturity in-progress -> validating. THE BENCH QUESTION IS ANSWERED and both product controls carry Fabio's values, not a metric's: sigmas 0.50-0.85 default 0.675, and cfg exposed as prompt strength at 1-3 - "1 to 3 sounds like the appropriate range, which is what I was already leaning towards before the tests, so that's settled." Nothing on this card is waiting on a measurement now. What remains is other cards' work by this card's own scope line: audio pass-through (app-side), turning the op into a real Flow (needs its own card), and the demoted ground-truth invented-texture test. ONE VALUE STILL OPEN: the cfg DEFAULT. Recommend 3 - the graph's current pin of 1 is no guidance at all, so defaulting there ships a prompt-strength slider that does nothing until the user moves it.
Fabio closed the bench 2026-08-19 ('The video upscale is finished'); both slider ranges shipped unchanged in MPI-579.
